0.en: II. Perception, or the Thing and Deception

en: Immediate certainty does not take the true for itself, for its truth is the universal; it, however, wants to take the 'this'.
Perception, by contrast, takes what is for it the existent as a universal.
As universality is its principle in general, so too are its moments that immediately distinguish themselves within it: I a universal, and the object a universal.
That principle has come to be for us, and our taking up of perception is therefore no longer an appearing taking-up, like that of sense-certainty, but a necessary one.

In the coming-to-be of the principle, the two moments that in its appearance merely fall away have at the same time come to be: the one, namely, the movement of pointing out, the other the same movement but as something simple; the former perceiving, the latter the object.
The object is in essence the same as what the movement is: the movement is the unfolding and distinguishing of the moments, the object their being-gathered-together.
For us, or in itself, the universal as principle is the essence of perception, and against this abstraction the two distinguished ones, the perceiving and the perceived, are the unessential.

But in fact, because both are themselves the universal, or the essence, they are both essential; but since they relate to one another as opposed, only the one can be the essential in this relation, and the distinction of the essential and the unessential must distribute itself over them.

The one, determined as the simple, the object, is the essence, indifferent as to whether it is perceived or not; but perceiving, as the movement, is the inconstant, which can be or also not be, and the unessential.
zh: 直接确定性并不为自己取得真的东西，因为它的真理是普遍者；但它却要取得这一个。
知觉则相反，把对它来说是存在者的东西当作普遍者。
正如普遍性一般来说是它的原则，它的那些在它之内直接相互区别的环节也是如此：我是一个普遍者，对象也是一个普遍者。
那个原则对我们来说已经产生出来，因此我们对知觉的接受就不再像感性确定性的接受那样是一种显现着的接受，而是一种必然的接受。
在这个原则的产生过程中，那两个在它的现象里只是脱落出来的环节也同时产生出来了：一个是指认的运动，另一个是同一个运动，不过作为简单的东西；前者是知觉活动，后者是对象。
对象在本质上与那个运动是同一个东西：运动是诸环节的展开和区别，对象则是这些环节被聚集在一起的存在。
对我们来说，或者说自在地，作为原则的普遍者是知觉的本质，而相对于这个抽象来说，那两个有区别的东西，即知觉者和被知觉者，则是非本质的东西。
但实际上，因为两者本身都是普遍者，或者说都是本质，所以两者都是本质性的；不过，既然它们是作为对立的东西相互关联的，那么在这种关联中就只能是其中一个成为本质的东西，而本质的东西与非本质的东西的差别就必然分摊到它们身上。
被规定为简单者的那一个，即对象，是本质，至于它是否被知觉到，则无所谓；而知觉活动作为运动则是无常的东西，它可以在，也可以不在，并且是非本质的东西。

en: This object is now to be determined more closely, and this determination is briefly to be developed out of the result that has emerged; the more fully executed development does not belong here.
Since its principle, the universal, is a mediated one in its simplicity, it must express this as its nature on itself; it thereby shows itself as the thing of many properties.
The wealth of sensuous knowing belongs to perception, not to immediate certainty, on which it was only the incidental; for only the former has negation, difference, or manifoldness in its essence.
zh: 现在要对这个对象做更切近的规定，并且要从已经得出的结果出发，把这个规定简要地展开；更详尽的展开不属于这里。
既然它的原则，即普遍者，在它的简单性中是一个被中介的东西，它就必须在自己身上把这一点表达为自己的本性；它由此表明自己是具有许多属性的物。
感性知识的丰富属于知觉，而不属于直接确定性，在直接确定性那里它只是附带的东西；因为只有知觉才在自己的本质中具有否定、差别或杂多性。

en: The 'this' is therefore posited as not this, or as sublated, and thereby not as nothing, but as a determinate nothing, or a nothing of a content, namely of the 'this'.
The sensuous is thereby itself still present, but not, as it should be in immediate certainty, as the meant singular, but as universal, or as that which will determine itself as property.

Sublating presents its true doubled meaning, which we have seen in the negative; it is a negating and a preserving at the same time; the nothing, as the nothing of the 'this', preserves immediacy and is itself sensuous, but a universal immediacy.
— But being is a universal in that it has mediation, or the negative, on it; in that it expresses this on its immediacy, it is a distinguished, determinate property.
Thereby many such properties are at the same time posited, the one the negative of the others.

In that they are expressed in the simplicity of the universal, these determinacies, which properly are properties only through a further determination that comes to them, relate to themselves, are indifferent to one another, each for itself, free from the other.

But the simple, self-same universality itself is again distinguished and free from these its determinacies; it is the pure relating-to-itself, or the medium in which all these determinacies are, thus permeating one another in it as in a simple unity, without, however, touching one another; for precisely through participation in this universality they are indifferent for themselves.

— This abstract universal medium, which can be called thinghood in general or the pure essence, is nothing other than the Here and Now as it has proved itself, namely as a simple together of many; but the many are, in their determinacy, themselves simply universal.

This salt is a simple Here and at the same time manifold; it is white and also sharp, also cubically shaped, also of a determinate weight, etc. All these many properties are in a single Here, in which they therefore permeate one another; none has a different Here from the other, but each is everywhere in the same Here in which the other is; and at the same time, without being separated by different Heres, they do not affect one another in this permeation; the white does not affect or alter the cubic, neither of them the sharp, etc., but since each is itself a simple relating-to-itself, it lets the others be at rest and relates to them only through the indifferent 'also'.
This 'also' is therefore the pure universal itself, or the medium, the thinghood that thus gathers them together.
zh: 所以这一个被设定为非这一个，或者被设定为被扬弃了的，并且因此不是无，而是一个特定的无，或者说是一个内容上的无，即这一个的无。
感性之物由此本身仍然还在，但不是像它在直接确定性中应当的那样，作为被意谓的个别的东西，而是作为普遍者，或者作为那个将要把自己规定为属性的东西。
扬弃展现出它那真正的双重含义，这含义我们已经在否定物身上看到了；它同时既是否定，又是保存；这个无，作为这一个的无，把直接性保存下来，并且它本身是感性的，不过是一种普遍的直接性。
——但存在之所以是普遍者，是因为它在自己身上具有中介或否定；当它把这一点在它的直接性上表达出来时，它就是某种有区别的、特定的属性。
这样一来，许多这样的属性就同时被设定了，其中一个是其余东西的否定。
由于它们是在普遍者的简单性中被表达出来的，这些规定性——它们其实只有通过一个进一步加进来的规定才成为属性——就与自身相关，彼此漠不相关，每一个都自为地存在，独立于另一个。
但那简单的、自身相同的普遍性本身，又重新与它的这些规定性区别开来、独立于它们；它就是纯粹的与自身相关，或者就是那个介质，这些规定性全都在这介质之中，因而在它之中就像在一个简单的统一体中那样相互渗透，却并不相互接触；因为正是由于分有这个普遍性，它们才自为地漠不相关。
——这个抽象而普遍的介质，可以被称为一般的物性或纯粹的本质，它不外就是这里和这时，如它已经表明的那样，即作为许多东西的简单共在；但这许多东西在它们的规定性中本身就是简单的普遍者。

这块盐是一个简单的这里，同时又是杂多的；它是白的，又是咸的，又是立方形的，又有一定的重量，等等。所有这许多属性都在一个简单的这里之中，它们于是在其中相互渗透；没有一个拥有与另一个不同的这里，而是每一个都处处处在另一个所处的同一个这里之中；并且同时，由于并没有被不同的这里分隔开来，它们在这种相互渗透中并不相互影响；白色并不影响或改变立方形的东西，这两个也不影响辛辣的东西，等等，而是因为每一个本身就是简单的与自身相关，所以它让其他东西保持安宁，并且只是通过那个漠不相关的“也”才与它们相关。
所以这个“也”就是纯粹的普遍者本身，或者就是那个介质，即把它们这样聚集起来的物性。

en: In this relation that has come about, only the character of positive universality has so far been observed and developed; but another side still presents itself, which must also be taken in here.

Namely, if the many determinate properties were absolutely indifferent and related throughout only to themselves, they would not be determinate; for they are so only insofar as they distinguish themselves and relate to others as opposed.

But according to this opposition they cannot be together in the simple unity of their medium, which is as essential to them as the negation; the distinguishing of them, insofar as it is not an indifferent but an excluding, other-negating one, therefore falls outside this simple medium; and this is therefore not only an 'also', an indifferent unity, but also a One, an excluding unity.
— The One is the moment of negation, as it itself relates to itself in a simple way and excludes the other, and whereby thinghood is determined as thing.

On the property, the negation is determinacy, which is immediately one with the immediacy of being — which, through this unity with the negation, is universality; but as the One it is as it is freed from this unity with the opposite and is in and for itself.
zh: 在这个已经形成的关系中，还只是观察和展开了肯定的普遍性这一特征；但还有一面呈现出来，它也必须被一起纳入进来。
也就是说，如果这许多特定的属性完全漠不相关，并且完全只与自身相关，那它们就不是特定的属性；因为它们之所以是特定的，只是由于它们相互区别，并且作为对立的东西与其他东西相关。
但按照这种对立，它们就不能共处于它们那个介质的简单统一体之中，而这个统一体对它们来说和否定一样是本质性的；它们的区别，只要它不是漠不相关的区别，而是排他的、否定他者的区别，就落在这个简单的介质之外；因此这个介质就不只是一个“也”、一个漠不相关的统一体，而且是一个“一”、一个排他的统一体。
——“一”是否定这一环节，它本身以简单的方式与自身相关并排除他者，物性由此被规定为物。
在属性身上，否定作为规定性直接与存在的直接性合一，而存在的直接性通过这种与否定的统一就是普遍性；但作为“一”，否定则是它摆脱了与对立面的这种统一、并且自在自为地存在时的样子。

en: In these moments taken together the thing as the true of perception is complete, so far as it is necessary to develop it here.

It is α) the indifferent passive universality, the also of the many properties or rather matters, β) the negation likewise as simple, or the one, which excludes opposed properties, and γ) the many properties themselves, the relation of the two first moments, the negation as it relates to the indifferent element and therein spreads itself out as a multitude of differences; the point of singularity radiating out into the multiplicity in the medium of subsistence.

According to the side that these differences belong to the indifferent medium, they are themselves universal, relate only to themselves and do not affect one another; but according to the side that they belong to the negative unity, they are at the same time exclusive, yet have this opposed relation necessarily to properties that are removed from their also.

The sensuous universality or the immediate unity of being and of the negative is only thus property, insofar as the one and the pure universality are developed out of it and distinguished from one another and it joins these together with one another; this relation of the same to the pure essential moments first completes the thing.
zh: 在这些环节合在一起时，作为知觉的真的东西的物就完成了，就这里有必要展开它而言。
它是 α) 无所谓地被动的普遍性，许多属性或者说许多质料的“也”，β) 同样作为单纯的否定，或者说一，即排斥对立属性的一，以及 γ) 许多属性本身，即前两个环节的关系，即否定，它如何与无所谓的元素发生关系并在其中展开为一堆差别；个别性的点，在持存的介质中放射为多。
就这些差别属于无所谓的介质这一方面看，它们本身就是普遍的，只与自身发生关系，并不互相触动；但就它们属于否定的统一这一方面看，它们同时是排斥性的，不过这种对立的关联必然落在那些已从它们的“也”中被移开的属性上。
感性的普遍性或者说存在与否定物的直接统一，只有这样才是属性，即一和纯粹普遍性已从它那里展开、并彼此区别开来，而它把这两者联结在一起；正是这种它们与那些纯粹本质环节的关系，才使物完成。

en: Such now is the constitution of the thing of perception; and consciousness is determined as perceiving insofar as this thing is its object; it has only to take it and to conduct itself as pure apprehension; what thereby results for it is the true.
If it itself did anything in this taking, it would alter the truth by such adding or omitting.
Since the object is the true and universal, self-same, but consciousness is the changeable and unessential, it can happen to it that it apprehends the object incorrectly and deceives itself.
The perceiving consciousness is conscious of the possibility of deception; for in the universality which is the principle, otherness itself is immediately for it, but as the null, the sublated.
Its criterion of truth is therefore self-sameness, and its conduct, to apprehend as self-same.

Since at the same time the different is for it, it is a relating of the different moments of its apprehension to one another; but if in this comparison an inequality comes to light, this is not an untruth of the object, for it is the self-same, but of perceiving.
zh: 知觉的物现在就是这样构成的；而意识就它是知觉着的而言是被规定了的，只要这个物是它的对象；它只需接受这个物，并把自己当作纯粹的领会来行事；由此对它产生出来的东西，就是真的东西。
如果它自己在这种接受中做了什么，它就会通过这样的增添或省略改变真理。
既然对象是真的东西和普遍的东西、自身等同的东西，而意识则是可变化的东西和非本质的东西，那么意识就可能发生这样的事：它不正确地领会对象并骗了自己。
知觉着的意识有对错觉之可能性的意识；因为在那作为原则的普遍性中，他在本身直接就为它而存在，但却是作为无的东西、被扬弃了的东西。
因此它的真理尺度就是自身等同，而它的行为方式就是作为自身等同的东西去领会。
既然同时那有差别的东西也为它而存在，它就是把它领会中的不同环节互相联系起来；但如果在这样的比较中显出一种不等同，那么这就不是对象的不真，因为对象是自身等同的东西，而是知觉的不真。

en: Let us now see what experience consciousness makes in its actual perceiving.
For us it is already contained in the development of the object and of the conduct of consciousness toward it just given, and will only be the development of the contradictions present therein.
– The object that I take up presents itself as purely one; also I become aware of the property in it that is universal, but thereby goes beyond singularity.
The first being of the objective essence as a one was therefore not its true being; since it is the true, the untruth falls into me, and the apprehension was not correct.
I must, on account of the universality of the property, rather take the objective essence as a community in general.
I now further perceive the property as determinate.
As one opposed to another and excluding it.

I therefore in fact did not apprehend the objective essence correctly when I determined it as a community with others or as continuity, and must rather, on account of the determinacy of the property, separate the continuity and posit it as an excluding one.
zh: 现在我们来看一看，意识在它现实的知觉中取得什么经验。
它对我们来说已经包含在刚才给出的对象和意识对对象的行为方式的展开中，而且将只是其中现存的那些矛盾的展开。
– 我接受到的对象把自己呈现为纯粹的一；我也在它身上觉察到那个普遍的、但因此就超出个别性的属性。
所以，对象性本质作为一的那种最初的存在并不是它的真正存在；既然它是真的东西，不真就落到我身上，而领会也就不正确。
由于属性的普遍性，我反倒必须把对象性本质当作一般的共同体。
我现在进一步把属性知觉为被规定了的。
即与另一个对立并排斥它的。
所以，当我把对象性本质规定为与别的他者的共同体或规定为连续性时，我实际上并没有正确地领会它，并且由于属性的规定性，我反倒必须把连续性分离开，把它设定为排斥性的一。

en: On the separated one I find many such properties, which do not affect one another but are indifferent to one another; I therefore did not perceive the object correctly when I apprehended it as an excluding one, but it is, as before merely continuity in general, so now a universal common medium, in which many properties as sensuous universals, each for itself, are and as determinate exclude the others.

But the simple and true that I perceive is hereby also not a universal medium, but the individual property for itself, which, however, is thus neither property nor a determinate being; for it is now neither on a one nor in relation to others.
But it is property only on the one and determinate only in relation to others.

As this pure self-relating it remains only sensuous being in general, since it no longer has the character of negativity on it; and the consciousness for which a sensuous being now is, is only a meaning, i.e. it has quite gone out of perceiving and returned into itself.
But the sensuous being and meaning itself passes over into perceiving; I am thrown back to the beginning and again drawn into the same cycle, which sublates itself in every moment and as a whole.
zh: 在被分离开的一身上，我找到许多这样的属性，它们并不互相触动，而是彼此无所谓的；所以我把它当作一个排斥性的东西来领会时，并没有正确地知觉对象，相反，它正如刚才只是一般的连续性，现在则是一个普遍共同的介质，其中许多属性作为感性的普遍性，每一个都自为地存在，并作为被规定了的属性排斥其余的属性。
但我所知觉到的那个单纯的东西和真的东西，由此也不是一个普遍的介质，而是自为的个别属性，不过这样一来它既不是属性，也不是被规定了的存在；因为它现在既不在一个一身上，也不处在与别的他者的关系中。
但它只有在一身上才是属性，只有在与别的他者的关系中才是被规定了的。
作为这种纯粹的自返自身，它始终只是一般感性的存在，因为它已不再具有否定性的品格；而那现在有一个感性存在为对象的意识，只是一种意谓，也就是说，它已完全从知觉中走出来并返回自身之内。
不过感性的存在和意谓本身又过渡为知觉；我被抛回到开端，并且重新被卷进同一个在每一环节中以及作为整体都扬弃自己的循环。

en: Consciousness therefore necessarily runs through it again, but at the same time not in the same way as the first time.
For it has made the experience about perceiving that the result and the true of perceiving is its dissolution or the reflection into itself out of the true.

Thereby it has become determined for consciousness how its perceiving is essentially constituted, namely not a simple pure apprehension, but in its apprehension to be at the same time reflected out of the true into itself.
This return of consciousness into itself, which immediately mixes itself into the pure apprehension – for it has shown itself to be essential to perceiving – alters the true.
Consciousness at the same time recognizes this side as its own and takes it upon itself, whereby it will then keep the true object pure.

– Hereby there is now present in perceiving, as happened with sense-certainty, the side that consciousness is pressed back into itself, but at first not in the sense in which this was the case with that, as if the truth of perceiving fell into it; but rather it recognizes that the untruth that occurs therein falls into it.

Through this recognition, however, it is at the same time capable of sublating it; it distinguishes its apprehension of the true from the untruth of its perceiving, corrects this, and insofar as it itself undertakes this correction, the truth, as truth of perceiving, does indeed fall into it.

The conduct of consciousness that is now to be considered is therefore so constituted that it no longer merely perceives, but is also conscious of its reflection-into-itself and separates this from the simple apprehension itself.
zh: 所以意识必然又一次经历这个循环，但同时并不以第一次那样的方式。
因为它已就知觉取得了经验：知觉的结果和真的东西就是它的解体，或者说从真的东西返回自身之内的反思。
由此，对意识来说已确定下来：它的知觉本质上是怎么一回事，即不是一种单纯的纯粹领会，而是在它的领会中同时从真的东西出来、反思进自身之内。
意识这种返回自身之内，直接混入纯粹的领会——因为它已表明自己是知觉本质上固有的——，它改变了真的东西。
意识同时把这一方面认作它自己的方面，并把它承担起来，由此它就会纯粹地保有那真的对象。
– 于是现在在知觉这里，正如在感性确定性那里发生过的那样，出现了这样一面：意识被逼回自身之内，但起初并不是在感性确定性那里的那种意义上，仿佛知觉的真理落进了它里面；相反，它认识到，其中出现的不真落进了它里面。
但通过这种认识，它同时能够扬弃这种不真；它把对真的东西的领会同它知觉中的不真区别开来，纠正后者，而就它自己进行这种纠正而言，真理作为知觉的真理确实落进了它里面。
因此，现在要考察的意识的行为方式是这样构成的：它不再只是知觉，而且也意识到它的自身反思，并把这种反思同单纯的领会本身分离开来。

en: I thus first become aware of the thing as One, and I have to hold it fast in this true determination; if in the movement of perceiving something contradictory to it occurs, this is to be recognized as my reflection.

Now there also occur in perception various properties, which seem to be properties of the thing; but the thing is One, and of this variety, through which it would cease to be One, we are conscious that it falls in us.
This thing is therefore in fact only white when brought to our eye, also sharp to our tongue, also cubical to our touch, etc.
The complete diversity of these sides we take not from the thing but from ourselves; they thus fall apart for us at our eye, which is quite distinct from the tongue, etc.
We are thus the universal medium in which such moments separate themselves and are for themselves.
Through this, then, that we regard the determinacy of being a universal medium as our reflection, we obtain the self-equality and truth of the thing, that it is One.
zh: 所以，我先觉察到物是“一”，并且必须把它在这个真的规定里牢牢抓住；如果在知觉的运动中出现某种与它相矛盾的东西，那就得把这东西认作我的反思。
现在在知觉中也出现各种特性，它们显得是物的特性；然而物是一，而对于这种差异，即物借以不再是一的那种差异，我们意识到它是落在我们里面的。
所以这个物事实上只是在被拿到我们眼睛跟前时才是白的，在被拿到我们舌头上时才是辛辣的，在被拿到我们的触觉上时才是立方的，等等。
这些方面的完全差异，我们不是从物那里、而是从我们这里取得的；它们在我们身上，在我们那只与舌头完全不同的眼睛等等上面，就这样彼此分开。
我们因此就是那种普遍的媒介，这些环节在其中彼此分离并自为地存在着。
这样，正是由于我们把“是普遍媒介”这个规定性看作我们的反思，我们就得到了物的自身等同性和真理，即它是一。

en: These various sides, however, which consciousness takes upon itself, are, each taken thus for itself as being in the universal medium, determinate; the white is only in opposition to the black, etc., and the thing is One precisely by opposing itself to others.

But it does not exclude others from itself insofar as it is One - for being One is the universal relating of itself to itself, and by the fact that it is One it is rather equal to all - but through determinacy.
The things themselves are therefore in and for themselves determinate; they have properties through which they distinguish themselves from others.
Insofar as the property is the thing's own property or a determinacy on the thing itself, the thing has several properties.

For first, the thing is the true, it is in itself; and what is on it, is on it as its own essence, not for the sake of others; thus secondly, the determinate properties are not only for the sake of other things and for other things, but on it itself; but they are determinate properties on it only in that they are several that distinguish themselves from one another; and thirdly, in that they are thus in thinghood, they are in and for themselves and indifferent to one another.

It is thus in truth the thing itself that is white and also cubical, also sharp, etc., or the thing is the also or the universal medium in which the many properties subsist outside one another without touching and sublating one another; and taken thus it is taken as the true.
zh: 但是，意识揽到自己身上的这些不同方面，每一个这样自为地、被看作处在普遍媒介之中时，就是有规定的；白只有在与黑等等的对立中才是白，而物恰恰由于与别的物相对立才是一。
但物并不是就它是“一”而言才把别的物从自身排除出去——因为是一就是普遍的自身关联，而且正由于它是一，它反倒与一切物等同——，而是通过规定性才把别的物排除出去。
所以物本身就是自在自为地有规定的；它们有特性，凭这些特性它们把自己与别的物区别开来。
既然特性是物自己的特性，或者是物自身上的一个规定性，那么物就有多个特性。
因为第一，物是真的东西，它是自在的；它身上有的东西，是作为它自己的本质在它身上，而不是为着别的物的缘故；所以第二，那些有规定的特性就不只是为着别的物的缘故、为着别的物，而是它自身上就有的；但它们只有在是多个彼此区别开来的特性时，才是它身上的有规定的特性；第三，由于它们这样处在物性中，它们就是自在自为的，并且彼此漠不相关。
所以实际上正是物本身才是白的，也是立方的，也是辛辣的，等等；或者说，物就是那个“也”，就是那种普遍的媒介，许多特性在其中彼此并列地存在着，既不互相接触，也不互相扬弃；而这样来看，物就被当作真的东西来看。

en: In this perceiving, however, consciousness is at the same time conscious that it also reflects itself into itself and that in perceiving the moment opposed to the also occurs.
But this moment is the unity of the thing with itself, which excludes difference from itself.
It is therefore this unity that consciousness has to take upon itself; for the thing itself is the subsistence of the many different and independent properties.
Thus it is said of the thing: it is white, also cubical and also sharp, etc.
But insofar as it is white, it is not cubical, and insofar as it is cubical and also white, it is not sharp, etc.
The setting-into-one of these properties belongs only to consciousness, which therefore must not let them coincide into one in the thing.
To that end it brings in the 'insofar', whereby it keeps them apart and keeps the thing as the also.
Properly speaking, the being-one is first taken upon itself by consciousness in such a way that what was called property is represented as free matter.
In this way the thing is raised to the true also, in that it becomes a collection of matters and, instead of being One, becomes a merely enclosing surface.
zh: 在这种知觉中，意识同时意识到自己也在自身中反思，并且意识到在知觉中出现了一个与“也”相对立的环节。
但这个环节就是物与自身的统一，这种统一把差别从自身中排除出去。
所以意识要揽到自己身上的正是这种统一；因为物本身就是那许多不同而独立的特性的持续存在。
于是人们就说：物是白的，也是立方的，也是辛辣的，等等。
但就它是白的而言，它不是立方的；而就它是立方的、也是白的而言，它不是辛辣的，等等。
把这些特性合而为一，只属于意识，因此意识不能让它们在物身上合而为一。
为此它把那个“就……而言”搬进来，靠它把这些特性分开，并把物保持为“也”。
严格说来，意识只有这样才能把“是一”揽到自己身上，即：那被称为特性的东西被表象为自由的物质。
这样，物就被提高为真正的“也”，因为它成了诸物质的一个集合，并且不再是“一”，而变成一个仅仅把物质包裹起来的表面。

en: If we look back at what consciousness previously took upon itself and now takes upon itself, what it previously ascribed to the thing and now ascribes to it, it turns out that it alternately makes both itself and the thing into both, into the pure, multiplicity-less One as well as into an also dissolved into independent matters.

Through this comparison consciousness thus finds that not only does its taking of the true have in it the difference of apprehending and of going-back-into-itself, but that rather the true itself, the thing, shows itself in this doubled way.

Hereby the experience is present that the thing presents itself to the apprehending consciousness in a determinate way, but at the same time is out of the way in which it offers itself and reflected into itself, or has on it itself an opposed truth.
zh: 如果我们回头看意识先前揽到自己身上、现在又揽到自己身上的东西，看它先前归给物、现在又归给物的东西，那么结果就是：它轮流地既把自己、也把物，都弄成这两者，既弄成纯粹的不含多的“一”，也弄成分解为独立物质的一个“也”。
所以意识通过这种比较发现：不只是它对真的东西的采取在自己身上带有领会与返回自身之间的差异，而是真的东西本身、即物，反而以这种双重的方式显现出来。
这样就有了这样的经验：物对进行领会的意识以一种特定的方式呈现出来，但同时它又从那呈现自己的方式中走出来、返回到自身之中，或者说它自身上有一种相反的真理。

en: Consciousness has thus also come out of this second way of comporting itself in perceiving, namely of taking the thing as the true self-equal and itself as the unequal, as that which goes back into itself out of the equality; and the object is now for it this whole movement, which previously was distributed between the object and consciousness.
The thing is One, reflected into itself; it is for itself, but it is also for an other, and indeed it is another for itself than it is for an other.

Accordingly the thing is for itself and also for an other, a doubled, different being, but it is also One; the being-one, however, contradicts this its diversity; accordingly consciousness would again have to take this setting-into-one upon itself and to keep it away from the thing.
It would therefore have to say that the thing, insofar as it is for itself, is not for others.
But the being-one also belongs to the thing itself, as consciousness has experienced; the thing is essentially reflected into itself.

The also, or the indifferent difference, thus indeed falls into the thing as does the being-one, but, since both are different, not into the same thing, but into different things; the contradiction that is on the objective essence in general distributes itself over two objects.

The thing is thus indeed in and for itself equal to itself, but this unity with itself is disturbed by other things; thus the unity of the thing is preserved and at the same time the otherness outside it as well as outside consciousness.
zh: 所以意识也从这第二种在知觉中行事的方式里走出来了，即不再把物当作真的自身等同的东西、而把自己当作不等同的东西、当作从等同中退出来返回到自身的东西；现在对象对它来说就是这整个运动，而这个运动先前是分给对象和意识两边的。
物是一，是返回自身之中的；它是自为的，但它也是为一个他者的，而且它自为地是另一个东西，与它为一个他者所是的东西不同。
这样一来，物既是自为的，又是为一个他者的，是一种双重的、不同的存在，但它又是一；然而“是一”与它这种差异相矛盾；这样一来，意识又得把这个合而为一揽到自己身上，并把它从物那里挡开。
所以它就得说：物就它是自为的而言，不是为他者的。
可是照意识所经验到的，物自己也具有“是一”；物本质上就是返回自身之中的。
所以“也”或漠不相关的差别，固然和“是一”一样落在物里面，但既然两者不同，它就不落在同一个物里面，而是落在不同的物里面；一般说来，对象性本质上有的那个矛盾，就分配到两个对象上。
所以物固然是自在自为地自身等同的，但这种与自身的统一被别的物搅乱了；这样，物的统一就保住了，同时他在也既在物之外、又在意识之外。

en: Now although the contradiction of the objective essence is thus distributed among different things, the difference will nevertheless come upon the separate single thing itself.
The different things are therefore posited as being for themselves; and the conflict falls into them in such a reciprocal way that each is different not from itself, but only from the other.

But each is hereby itself determined as something distinguished and has on it the essential difference from the others, yet not in such a way that this would be an opposition on it itself, but rather for itself it is simple determinacy, which makes up its essential character that distinguishes it from others.
In fact, to be sure, since difference is on it, that difference is necessarily on it as the actual difference of manifold qualities.
But because determinacy makes up the essence of the thing, whereby it distinguishes itself from others and is for itself, this other manifold quality is the unessential.

The thing thus indeed has in its unity the doubled “insofar” on it, but with unequal value, whereby this being-opposed does not become the actual opposition of the thing itself; rather, insofar as the thing comes into opposition through its absolute difference, it has that opposition against another thing outside it.
The other manifoldness is indeed also necessarily on the thing, so that it cannot stay away from it, but it is unessential to the thing.
zh: 虽然对象性的本质的矛盾就这样被分配到不同的物上面，但差别因此还是会落到那孤立的、个别的物本身之上。
于是不同的物被设定为自为的；而冲突这样交互地落入它们之中，以致每一个都不是与自身相异，而只是与他物相异。
但每一个由此本身就被规定为有差别的东西，并且在它身上具有与其他物相区别的本质的差别，然而又不是说这一点会是它自身之上的对立，而是说它自为地就是单纯的规定性，这种规定性构成它那种本质的、把它与他物区别开来的特性。
事实上，既然相异性在它身上，那么这种相异性就必然作为多种性状的现实的差别而在它身上。
但是，由于规定性构成物的本质，物凭此把自己与他物区别开来并自为地存在，所以这些其余的多种性状就是非本质的东西。
物由此在它的统一中虽然具有双重的“就……而言”，但带有不相等的价值，于是这种被对立状态就不是物自身的现实的对立；而是说，只要物通过它的绝对的差别而进入对立，它就是针对它之外的另一个物才有这种对立。
其余的杂多虽然也必然在物身上，以致它不能从物那里消失，但它对物来说是非本质的。

en: This determinacy, which makes up the essential character of the thing and distinguishes it from all others, is now so determined that the thing is thereby in opposition with others, but is supposed to preserve itself for itself in this opposition.

But it is a thing, or a being-for-itself One, only insofar as it does not stand in this relation to others; for in this relation it is rather the connection with another that is posited; and connection with another is the ceasing of being-for-itself.

Precisely through the absolute character and its being-opposed, it relates itself to others and is essentially only this comportment; but the relation is the negation of its independence, and the thing rather perishes through its essential property.
zh: 这种构成物的本质特性、并把物与所有其他物区别开来的规定性，现在被规定成这样：物由此处于与其他物的对立之中，却应当在这种对立中把自己保持为自为的。
但它只有在不处于这种对他物的关系之中时才是物，或者说才是自为存在的一；因为在这种关系中，被设定的反而是与他物的联系；而与他物的联系就是自为存在的终止。
正是通过这种绝对特性和它的被对立状态，物才与其他物发生关系，并且本质上只是这种相关活动；但关系是对它的独立性的否定，而物反而是通过它的本质属性而毁灭。

en: The necessity, for consciousness, of the experience that the thing perishes precisely through the determinacy that makes up its essence and its being-for-itself, can briefly be considered as follows according to the simple concept.

The thing is posited as being-for-itself, or as the absolute negation of all otherness, hence as absolute negation that relates only to itself; but the negation that relates to itself is a sublating of itself, or [this:] to have its essence in another.
zh: 对意识来说，物正是通过构成它的本质和它的自为存在的那种规定性而毁灭，这一经验的必然性按单纯的概念可以简短地这样来看。
物被设定为自为存在，或被设定为对一切他在的绝对否定，因而是绝对的、仅仅与自身相关的否定；但自己与自己相关的否定就是对自身的扬弃，或者说，[这就是]在另一个物中拥有自己的本质。

en: In fact, the determination of the object, as it has turned out, contains nothing else; it is supposed to have an essential property that makes up its simple being-for-itself, but in this simplicity also to have difference on itself, which is indeed supposed to be necessary, but is not supposed to make up the essential determinacy.

But this is a distinction that lies only in the words; the unessential, which is nevertheless at the same time supposed to be necessary, sublates itself, or is that which was just now called the negation of itself.
zh: 事实上，对象按照它所得出的样子，其规定包含的不是别的东西；它应当具有一种构成它的单纯自为存在的本质属性，但在这种单纯性中，它也应当在自身上具有相异性，这种相异性虽然应当是必然的，却不应当构成本质的规定性。
但这是一种只还存在于字面上的区分；那毕竟同时应当是必然的非本质的东西，把自己扬弃掉，或者说，就是刚才被称为对自身的否定的那个东西。

en: Hereby the last “insofar” falls away, the one that separated being-for-itself and being-for-another; the object is rather, in one and the same respect, the opposite of itself: for itself, insofar as it is for another, and for another, insofar as it is for itself.

It is for itself, reflected into itself, One; but this being-for-itself, reflected into itself, being-One is posited with its opposite, being for another, in a unity, and therefore only as something sublated; or this being-for-itself is just as unessential as that which alone was supposed to be the unessential, namely the relation to another.
zh: 于是那最后一个把自为存在和为他存在分开的“就……而言”也就消失了；对象反而在同一个方面是自己本身的反面：自为，就它是为他的而言，为他，就它是自为的而言。
它自为地、在自身中反思地是一；但这种自为的、在自身中反思的一的存在，是与它的对立面、即为他的存在处在一种统一之中，因而只是作为被扬弃的东西而被设定的；或者说，这种自为存在正如那唯独应当是非本质的东西一样是非本质的，那就是与他物的关系。

en: The object is hereby sublated in its pure determinacies, or in the determinacies that were supposed to make up its essentiality, just as it became something sublated in its sensuous being.

Out of sensuous being it becomes a universal; but this universal, since it comes from the sensuous, is essentially conditioned by it and therefore is not at all a truly self-identical universality, but one affected with an opposition, which therefore divides into the extremes of singularity and universality, of the One of properties and the “also” of free matters.

These pure determinacies seem to express essentiality itself, but they are only a being-for-itself that is afflicted with being for another; but since both are essentially in a unity, the unconditioned absolute universality is now present, and consciousness here first truly enters the realm of the understanding.
zh: 对象由此在它的纯粹规定性中，或在那些本应构成它的本质性的规定性中，同样被扬弃了，正如它在它的感性存在中成了被扬弃的东西一样。
从感性存在中它成了一个普遍的东西；但这个普遍的东西，既然来自感性之物，就本质上受感性之物制约，因而根本不是真正自身同一的普遍性，而是带有一种对立的普遍性，所以它分裂为个别性和普遍性这两个极端，分裂为诸属性的“一”和自由质料的“也”。
这些纯粹的规定性看起来表达着本质性本身，但它们只是一种带有为他存在的自为存在；不过，既然两者本质上处在一种统一之中，那么现在就有了无条件的绝对普遍性，而意识在这里才真正进入知性的王国。

en: Sensuous singularity thus indeed vanishes in the dialectical movement of immediate certainty and becomes universality, but only sensuous universality.

Meaning has vanished, and perception takes the object as it is in itself, or as a universal in general; singularity therefore emerges on it as true singularity, as the being-in-itself of the One, or as being-reflected into itself.

But it is still a conditioned being-for-itself, alongside which another being-for-itself occurs, the universality opposed to singularity and conditioned by it; but these two contradictory extremes are not merely alongside one another, but in a unity; or, what is the same, what both have in common, being-for-itself, is afflicted with opposition in general, that is, it is at the same time not a being-for-itself.

These moments the sophistry of perception seeks to save from their contradiction and to hold fast through the distinction of respects, through the “also” and the “insofar”, and finally to grasp the true through the distinction of the unessential and of an essence opposed to it.

But these expedients, instead of keeping deception away from the apprehending, prove rather themselves to be null, and the true, which is supposed to be won through this logic of perception, proves to be, in one and the same respect, the opposite, and thereby to have as its essence the universality devoid of distinction and determination.
zh: 于是感性个别性虽然在直接确定性的辩证运动中消失，并成为普遍性，但只是感性普遍性。
意谓已经消失，而知觉把对象当作它自在的样子，或一般地当作普遍的东西；因此个别性在对象身上作为真的个别性、作为“一”的自在存在、或作为在自身中被反思的状态而出现。
但它还是一个有条件的自为存在，在它旁边还有另一个自为存在出现，即与个别性相对立并由个别性制约的普遍性；但这两个互相矛盾的极端不仅并排存在，而且处在一种统一之中；或者，同样可以说，两者的共同的东西即自为存在，带有一般意义上的对立，也就是说，它同时并不是一个自为存在。
知觉的诡辩力图把这些环节从它们的矛盾中救出来，并通过区分各种方面、通过“也”和“就……而言”把它们把住不放，最后还通过区分非本质的东西和一种与它相对立的本质来抓住真的东西。
但这些权宜之计不但没有在把握中挡住错觉，反而表明自己本身是虚无的，而那本应通过这种知觉的逻辑获得的真的东西，则表明自己在同一个方面就是反面，并因此把无区分、无规定性的普遍性作为自己的本质。

en: These empty abstractions of singularity and of the universality opposed to it, as also of the essence that is linked with an unessential, of an unessential that is nevertheless at the same time necessary, are the powers whose play the perceiving, often so-called sound common sense is; it, which takes itself for the solid real consciousness, is in perception only the play of these abstractions; it is in general always poorest precisely where it means to be richest.

While it is driven around by these null essences, thrown from the one into the arms of the other, and, in its sophistry, endeavors alternately to hold fast and to assert now the one, then the directly opposite one, and thereby resists the truth, it means of philosophy that philosophy has to do only with thought-things.

It does indeed also have to do with them and recognizes them as the pure essences, as the absolute elements and powers; but thereby it recognizes them at the same time in their determinacy and is therefore master over them, while that perceiving understanding takes them for the true and is sent by them from one errancy into another.

It itself does not come to the consciousness that it is such simple essences that rule in it, but means always to have to do with quite solid material and content, just as sense-certainty does not know that the empty abstraction of pure being is its essence; but in fact it is they upon which it runs through and back and forth through all material and content; they are the coherence and the dominion of the same, and alone that which the sensuous is as essence for consciousness, that which determines its relations to it and upon which the movement of perception and of its true runs its course.

This course, a constantly alternating determining of the true and sublating of this determining, properly constitutes the daily and constant life and bustle of the perceiving consciousness that means to move in the truth.

In this it proceeds unstoppably to the result of the like sublating of all these essential essences or determinacies, but in each single moment it is conscious only of this one determinacy as the true, and then again of the opposite one.
It does indeed scent their unessentiality; to save them from the threatening danger, it passes over into sophistry, to assert now as the true what it itself just now asserted as the untrue.

To what this understanding is properly to be driven by the nature of these untrue essences — to bring together the thoughts of that universality and singularity, of the “also” and the One, of that essentiality that is necessarily linked with an unessentiality, and of an unessential that is nevertheless necessary, the thoughts of these non-essences, and thereby to sublate them — against this it struggles by means of the props of the “insofar” and of the different respects, or by taking the one thought upon itself in order to keep the other separate and as the true one.
But the nature of these abstractions brings them together in and for themselves; sound common sense is their prey, which drives it around in their whirling circle.

While it wants to give them the truth by now taking their untruth upon itself, now again calling the deception a semblance of the unreliable things and separating the essential from something that is necessary to them and yet is supposed to be unessential, and holding fast to the former as their truth against the latter, it thereby does not preserve their truth for them, but gives itself the untruth.
zh: 这些关于个别性、关于与它相对立的普遍性，以及关于那与非本质的东西相结合的本质、关于一种毕竟同时是必然的非本质的东西的空洞抽象，就是那些力量，而进行知觉的、通常所谓的健全人类知性，就是这些力量的游戏；它自以为是坚实的、实在的意识，在知觉中却只是这些抽象的游戏；它总之恰恰在意谓自己最丰富的地方总是最贫乏。
它被这些虚无的本质驱赶着，从这一个被抛进另一个的怀里，并且凭它的诡辩轮流地一会儿要把这一个、一会儿要把正相反的那一个把住并加以主张，就此与真理相对抗，这时它意谓哲学只与思想之物打交道。
哲学确实也与它们打交道，并把它们认作纯粹的本质、认作绝对的元素和力量；但这样一来，它同时也在它们的规定性中认识它们，因而就是它们的主人，而那个进行知觉的知性却把它们当作真的东西，于是被它们从一个迷误打发到另一个迷误。
它自己并没有意识到，在它之中起支配作用的正是这样一些单纯的本质性，反而总是意谓自己面对的是完全坚实的质料和内容，正如感性确定性并不知道，纯粹存在的空洞抽象就是它的本质；但事实上，正是它们，它穿过一切质料和内容、来回地绕着它们跑；它们就是这些质料和内容的联系和支配，并且唯独是感性之物作为本质对意识而言所是的东西，是规定意识与感性之物的关系、并且是知觉及其真的东西的运动在其中进行的东西。
这一过程，即不断地交替规定真的东西又扬弃这种规定，其实就构成了那进行知觉的、并且意谓自己在真理中活动的意识的日常而持续的生活和忙碌。
它在这一过程中不可阻挡地走向对所有这些本质性的本质性或规定性作同样的扬弃这一结果，但在每一个个别环节中，它都只意识到这一个规定性是真的，随后又只意识到那相反的规定性。
它确实嗅到了它们的非本质性；为了把它们从这逼近的危险中救出来，它就转入诡辩，把它自己刚才还主张为非真的东西，现在当作真的东西来主张。
这些不真的本质的本性究竟要把这种知性逼向什么，——把关于那种普遍性和个别性、关于“也”和一、关于那种与非本质性必然结合在一起的本质性、关于一种毕竟必然的非本质的东西的诸思想，把关于这些非本质物的诸思想聚合起来，并由此扬弃它们，——知性就凭“就……而言”和各个不同方面的支撑来抵抗这件事，或者靠把其中一个思想承担到自己身上，以便把另一个思想分离出来并作为真的东西保留下来。
但这些抽象的本性却使它们自在自为地聚合起来；健全的人类知性就是它们的猎物，而它们就在自己那旋转的圆圈中把它赶来赶去。
它想由此给它们真理，即时而把它们的非真承担到自己身上，时而又把错觉称为不可靠的物的假象，并把本质的东西与一种对它们来说是必然的、却又应当是非本质的东西分离开来，把前者作为它们的真理而与后者对立地坚持住，这样一来它却并没有为它们保住它们的真理，反倒把非真给了自己。

23.en: III. Force and Understanding, Appearance and the Supersensuous World
23.zh: III. 力与知性，现象与超感性世界

en: In the dialectic of sense-certainty, hearing and seeing, etc., have passed away for consciousness, and as perception it has come to thoughts, which however it first brings together in the unconditioned universal.

This unconditioned would now itself again be nothing other than the extreme of being-for-itself stepping to one side, if it were taken as a calm simple essence, for then the non-essence would stand opposed to it; but related to this, it would itself be unessential and consciousness would not have got beyond the deception of perception; however, it has turned out to be such a one as has returned into itself out of such a conditioned being-for-itself.
– This unconditioned universal, which is now the true object of consciousness, is still as an object of it; it has not yet grasped its concept as concept.

The two are essentially to be distinguished; for consciousness the object has returned into itself out of the relation to an other and has thereby become concept in itself; but consciousness is not yet for itself itself the concept, and therefore it does not recognize itself in that reflected object.
For us this object has become such through the movement of consciousness that the latter is interwoven with the becoming of the object and the reflection on both sides is the same, or only one.

But because in this movement consciousness had as its content only the objective meaning, not consciousness as such, the result is for it to be posited in objective significance and consciousness still to step back from what has come to be, so that for it the same, as something objective, is the essence.
zh: 在感性确定性的辩证法里，对意识来说，听和看等等已经消逝了，而作为知觉，意识已经达到了思想，只是它要到无条件的普遍者那里才把这些思想聚合起来。
这个无条件者本身现在又会无非是退到一边去的自为存在那一极端，如果它被当作平静而单纯的本质的话，因为这样一来，非本质就与它对立了；但如果与这个非本质相关，它自己就会是非本质的，意识也就没有从知觉的错觉里走出来；不过它已经表明自己是这样的东西，即它从这样一种有条件的自为存在返回到自身之内了。
——这个无条件的普遍者现在已经是意识的真的对象，它还只是作为意识的对象；它还没有把自己的概念作为概念来把握。
两者必须本质上区别开来；对意识来说，对象已经从与一个他物的关系中返回到自身之内，并因此自在成了概念；但意识还不是为它自己的概念，因此它在那被反思的对象里认不出自己。
对我们来说，这个对象是通过意识的运动才这样生成的：意识被编织进了对象的生成过程，而双方的反思是同一个，或者说只是一个。
但是，因为意识在这场运动里只把对象性的意谓、而不是把意识本身当作自己的内容，所以对它来说，结果必须以对象性的意义来设定，而意识还从生成之物那里退回来，以致这生成之物作为对象性的东西就是本质。

en: The understanding has thereby indeed sublated its own untruth and the untruth of the object; and what has come to be for it thereby is the concept of the true, as the true that is in itself, which is not yet concept or which lacks the being-for-itself of consciousness and which the understanding, without knowing itself therein, lets be granted.
This drives its essence for itself, so that consciousness has no share in its free realization, but merely looks on at it and purely apprehends it.

We have herewith for the present still to take its place and to be the concept which develops what is contained in the result; on this developed object, which offers itself to consciousness as a being, consciousness will first become comprehending consciousness.
zh: 知性由此虽然扬弃了它自己的不真和对象的不真；而它由此所得到的东西，就是真的东西的概念，作为自在存在着的真的东西，这个真的东西还不是概念，或者说还缺少意识的自为存在，而知性并不知道自己在其中，就任它自行其是。
这个真的东西自为地推动它自己的本质，以致意识对它的自由实在化没有任何份，而只是旁观它，并纯粹地把握它。
我们由此还首先得站到它的位置上，成为那个把结果中包含的东西展开出来的概念；在这个展开出来的、作为存在者呈现给意识的对象上，意识才第一次成为以概念把握的意识。

en: The result was the unconditioned universal, at first in the negative and abstract sense that consciousness negated its one-sided concepts and abstracted them, namely gave them up.
But the result has in itself the positive meaning that in it the unity of being-for-itself and being-for-another, or the absolute opposition, is immediately posited as the same essence.

It seems at first to concern only the form of the moments in relation to one another; but being-for-itself and being-for-another is just as much the content itself, because the opposition in its truth cannot have any other nature than that which has resulted in the result, namely that the content held to be true in perception in fact belongs only to the form and resolves itself into its unity.
This content is at the same time universal; there can be no other content that through its particular constitution would withdraw itself from returning into this unconditioned universality.
Such a content would be some determinate way of being for itself and of relating itself to others.
But to be for itself and to relate itself to others in general constitutes its nature and essence, whose truth is to be unconditioned universal; and the result is absolutely universal.
zh: 这个结果就是无条件的普遍者，首先是在否定的、抽象的意义上，即意识否定了自己那些片面的概念，把它们抽象掉，也就是把它们放弃了。
但这个结果自在地具有肯定的意义，即其中自为存在与为他存在的统一，或者说绝对对立，是直接作为同一个本质被设定起来的。
这起初似乎只涉及各环节相互之间的形式；但自为存在和为他存在同样也是内容本身，因为对立在其真理中不可能有别的本性，只能是结果里已经得出的那种本性，即知觉里被当作真的内容实际上只属于形式，并消解到形式的统一里去。
这个内容同时是普遍的；不可能有别的什么内容，凭着自己特殊的性状就能逃避回到这种无条件的普遍性里去。
这样一个内容会是某种特定的方式，去自为存在并与他物发生关系。
但一般地自为存在并与他物发生关系，就构成它的本性和本质，而它们的真理就是成为无条件的普遍者；这个结果则是彻底普遍的。

en: But because this unconditioned universal is object for consciousness, the difference of form and content emerges in it, and in the shape of the content the moments have the appearance in which they first presented themselves, namely to be on the one hand the universal medium of many existing matters and on the other hand the one reflected into itself, in which their independence is extinguished.
The former is the dissolution of the independence of the thing, or the passivity that is a being for another, the latter however being-for-itself.
It is to be seen how these moments present themselves in the unconditioned universality that is their essence.

It is evident at first that, just because they are only in this, they no longer lie apart at all, but are essentially sides that sublate themselves in themselves, and only their transition into one another is posited.
zh: 但因为这个无条件的普遍者是意识的对象，所以形式与内容的差别就在它身上出现了，而在内容的形态里，各环节具有它们最初呈现时的那种样子，即一方面是多条现存质料的普遍媒介，另一方面是自身反思的一，其中它们的独立性被消灭了。
前者是物的独立性的消解，或者说被动性，即一种为他存在，后者则是自为存在。
必须看看，这些环节在无条件的普遍性里、也就是在它们的本质里，是怎样呈现出来的。
首先可以看出，它们由于只存在于这种普遍性里，就根本不再彼此分开，而是本质上在它们自身中自我扬弃的方面，并且被设定的只是它们向彼此的过渡。

en: The one moment thus appears as the essence that has stepped to one side, as universal medium or as the subsistence of independent matters.
But the independence of these matters is nothing other than this medium; or this universal is thoroughly the multiplicity of such different universals.

The universal is in itself in inseparable unity with this multiplicity, but this means: these matters are, each where the other is; they interpenetrate one another, – but without touching one another, because conversely the many differentiated ones are just as independent.
Thereby their pure porosity or their being-sublated is at the same time posited.
This being-sublated again, or the reduction of this diversity to pure being-for-itself, is nothing other than the medium itself, and this is the independence of the differences.
Or the independently posited pass immediately into their unity, and their unity immediately into the unfolding, and this again back into the reduction.

But this movement is what is called force: the one moment of it, namely it as the spreading out of the independent matters in their being, is its expression, but it as the disappearance of these is the force driven back into itself out of its expression, or the proper force.
But first, the force driven back into itself must express itself; and secondly, in the expression it is just as much a force that is in itself, as in this being-in-itself it is expression.

– If we thus hold both moments in their immediate unity, then properly the understanding, to which the concept of force belongs, is the concept that bears the differentiated moments as differentiated; for in force itself they are not to be differentiated; the difference is herewith only in thought.
– Or in the above only the concept of force has as yet been posited, not its reality.

In fact, however, force is the unconditioned universal, which is for an other just as much as it is in itself; or which has the difference – for it is nothing other than being-for-another – in itself.

So that force may be in its truth, it must be entirely set free from thought and posited as the substance of these differences, i.e. first: it as this whole force remaining essentially in and for itself, and then: its differences as substantial or as moments subsisting for themselves.

Force as such, or as driven back into itself, is herewith for itself as an excluding one, for which the unfolding of the matters is another subsisting essence, and thus two distinct independent sides are posited.
But force is also the whole, or it remains what it is according to its concept, namely these differences remain pure forms, superficial vanishing moments.

The differences of the force driven back into itself, the proper force, and of the unfolding of the independent matters would at the same time not be at all, if they had no subsistence, or force would not be, if it did not exist in this opposed way, but that it exists in this opposed way means nothing other than: both moments are themselves at the same time independent.
– It is thus this movement of the constant self-empowerment of the two moments and of their sublating themselves again that is to be considered.

– It is evident in general that this movement is nothing other than the movement of perception, in which the two sides, the perceiving and the perceived, are at the same time, once as the apprehension of the true, one and undifferentiated, but thereby just as much each side is reflected into itself or for itself.

Here these two sides are moments of force; they are just as much in a unity, as this unity, which appears against the extremes that are for themselves as the middle, always decomposes into precisely these extremes, which only thereby are.

– The movement that previously presented itself as the self-destruction of contradictory concepts thus has here the objective form and is the movement of force, as whose result the unconditioned universal emerges as non-objective or as the inner of things.
zh: 所以，其中一个环节表现为退到一边去的本质，表现为普遍的媒介，或者表现为独立质料的持存。
但这些质料的独立性无非就是这个媒介；或者说，这个普遍者完全就是这类不同普遍者的杂多。
这个普遍者自在地与这种杂多处于不可分离的统一中，但这等于说：这些质料存在着，每一个都在另一个所在的地方；它们相互渗透，但并不相互接触，因为反过来，那许多有差别的东西同样是独立的。
由此同时也就设定了它们纯粹的孔隙性，或者说它们的被扬弃状态。
这个被扬弃状态，或者说把这种差别还原为纯粹自为存在，又无非就是媒介本身，而这个媒介就是各种差别的独立性。
或者说，被设定为独立的东西直接过渡到它们的统一，而它们的统一又直接过渡到展开，这展开再返回到还原。
但这种运动就是被称为力的东西：它的一个环节，即它作为独立质料在其存在中的铺开，是力的表现，而它作为这些质料的消失状态，则是从其表现中被推回到自身之内的力，或者说本真的力。
但第一，被推回到自身之内的力必须表现出来；第二，在表现中，它同样是存在于自身之内的力，正如它在这种存在于自身之内就是表现。
——我们这样把两个环节保持在它们的直接统一中，那么其实，力这个概念所隶属的知性，就是那个把有差别的各环节作为有差别的东西来承载的概念；因为就力自身来说，它们不应当有差别；所以差别仅仅在思想里。
——或者说，上面所设定的还只是力的概念，而不是它的实在性。
但实际上，力就是无条件的普遍者，它对他物而言是什么，同样也就自在地是什么；或者说，它在自己身上就具有差别——因为差别无非就是为他存在。
所以，力要存在于其真理中，就必须完全从思想中解放出来，被设定为这些差别的实体，也就是说：一方面，它作为这整个力本质上自在自为地持存着，另一方面，它的各种差别是实体性的，或者是自为地持存着的环节。
力作为这样的力，或者作为被推回到自身之内的力，因此是自为的、排斥性的一，对它来说，质料的展开是另一个持存着的本质，这样就设定了两个有差别的、独立的方面。
但力也是整体，或者说，力保持着它按自己的概念所是的东西，即这些差别保持为纯粹的形式，表面的、消逝着的环节。
被推回到自身之内的本真的力与独立质料的展开之间的那些差别，如果它们没有一种持存，也就同时根本不会存在；或者说，力如果不在这种对立的方式上存在，它就不会存在，但它在这样对立的方式上存在，无非是说：两个环节本身同时是独立的。
——所以，要考察的就是两个环节不断独立化、又不断自我扬弃的这种运动。
——一般可以看出，这种运动无非就是知觉的运动，其中两个方面，即知觉者和被知觉者，同时一度作为真的东西的把握而是一体的、无差别的，但与此同时，每一方面又同样是自身反思的，或者说是自为的。
在这里，这两个方面是力的环节；它们同样处于一个统一体中，而这个统一体相对于那些自为存在的极端表现为中间项，它又总是分解为正是这些极端，而极端只有通过这种分解才存在。
——先前表现为互相矛盾的概念之自我消灭的那种运动，在这里因此具有了对象性的形式，并且是力的运动，作为它的结果，无条件的普遍者作为非对象性的东西、或者说作为物的内在而出现。

en: Force, as it has been determined, in that it is represented as such or as reflected into itself, is the one side of its concept; but [it is represented] as a substantiated extreme, and indeed the one posited under the determinacy of the One.
Hereby the subsistence of the developed matters is excluded from it and is an other than it.
Since it is necessary that it itself be this subsistence, or that it express itself, its expression presents itself in such a way that that other accedes to it and solicits it.
But in fact, since it necessarily expresses itself, it has this, which was posited as another essence, on itself.

It must be retracted that it was posited as a One and its essence, to express itself, as an other acceding to it from outside; it is rather itself this universal medium of the subsistence of the moments as matters; or it has expressed itself, and what was supposed to be the other, the soliciting [factor], is rather it.
It therefore now exists as the medium of the developed matters.

But it equally essentially has the form of the sublatedness of the subsisting matters, or is essentially One; this being-one is hereby now, since it is posited as the medium of matters, an other than it, and it has this its essence outside it.
But since it must necessarily be this, as which it is not yet posited, this other accedes and solicits it to reflection into itself, or sublates its expression.

But in fact it is itself this being-reflected-into-itself or this sublatedness of expression; the being-one vanishes, as it appeared, namely as an other, it is it itself, it is force driven back into itself.
zh: 力，正如它已被规定的那样，当它被表象为力本身或表象为在自身中反思着的时候，就是它的概念的一面；但却是被实体化的极端，而且是被设定在“一”的规定性之下的那个极端。
这样一来，已经展开的质料的持存就被排除在力之外，而且是不同于力的他者。
既然力本身必然是这种持存，或者说力必然表现自己，那么力的表现就呈现为这样：那个他者加到力身上来，并推动力。
但事实上，既然力必然表现自己，它就在自身身上具有那个曾被设定为另一个本质的东西。
必须收回这一点：力曾被设定为一个“一”，而它表现自己这一本质曾被设定为一个从外面加到它身上来的他者；力毋宁说本身就是诸环节作为质料而持存的这个普遍介质；或者说，力已经表现了自己，而那个本该是另一个推动者的东西，毋宁说就是力。
所以力现在作为已经展开的质料的介质而存在。
但力同样本质上具有持存着的质料被扬弃这一形式，或者说本质上是一个“一”；既然力现在被设定为质料的介质，这个“一”之为一现在就成了不同于力的他者，而力把这个本质放在自己之外。
但既然力必然必须是它尚未被设定为的那个东西，这个他者就加进来，并推动力反思到自身之中，或者说扬弃力的表现。
但事实上，力本身就是这种在自身中反思，或者说这种表现的被扬弃；那个“一”之为一像它显现的那样消失了，即作为他者消失了，它就是它自己，它是被逼回自身之中的力。

en: That which appears as other and solicits it both to expression and to the return into itself is, as immediately results, itself force; for the other shows itself just as much as universal medium as as One, and in such a way that each of these shapes appears at the same time only as a vanishing moment.
Force has hereby, through the fact that an other is for it and it is for an other, on the whole not yet stepped outside its concept.
But at the same time two forces are present, the concept of both is indeed the same, but has gone out of its unity into duality.
Instead of the opposition remaining throughout essentially only a moment, it seems, through the diremption into wholly independent forces, to have withdrawn itself from the rule of unity.
What the state of affairs is with this independence is to be seen more closely.

First, the second force steps forth as the soliciting one, and indeed, as regards its content, as universal medium, over against the one which is determined as the solicited; but since that first one is essentially the alternation of these two moments and itself force, it is in fact likewise at first only universal medium, in that it is solicited thereto, and equally also only negative unity, or the soliciting [factor] for the return of force, through the fact that it is solicited.

Hereby this difference too, which took place between the two, that the one was supposed to be the soliciting and the other the solicited, transforms itself into the same exchange of the determinacies against each other.
zh: 那个作为他者出现、并且既推动力去表现、又推动力返回自身的东西，正如直接得出的那样，本身就是力；因为那另一个既表现为普遍介质，又表现为“一”，而且是如此表现：这两种形态中的每一种都同时只作为正在消失的环节出现。
这样一来，力由于有一个他者是为它的、而它又是为另一个他者的，就整个说来还没有走出它的概念。
但同时又存在着两个力，两者的概念诚然是同一个，但它已经走出了自己的统一而进入二重性。
对立本来完全本质上只是一个环节，现在它却通过分裂成完全独立的力，似乎已经摆脱了统一的统治。
这种独立性到底是怎么回事，还要更仔细地看一看。
首先，第二个力作为推动者出现，而且按其内容来说是作为普遍介质，与那个被规定为被推动者的力相对立；但既然前一个本质上就是这两个环节的交替，并且本身就是力，那么它事实上同样首先只是普遍介质，因为它是被推动去成为普遍介质的，同样也只是否定的统一，或者说只是使力返回自身的推动者，因为它是被推动的。
于是，两者之间曾有的这个差别，即一个该是推动者、另一个该是被推动者，也就转变为双方规定性的同一种互换。

en: The play of the two forces hereby consists in this opposed determinateness of both, in their being-for-each-other within this determination, and in the absolute immediate confounding of the determinations, – a transition through which alone these determinations are, in which the forces seem to appear independently.

The soliciting force, e.g., is posited as universal medium, and on the other hand the solicited one as force driven back; but the former is itself universal medium only through the fact that the other is force driven back; or the latter is rather the soliciting [factor] for the former and first makes the same into a medium.

The former has its determinacy only through the other and is soliciting only insofar as it is solicited by the other to be soliciting; and it just as immediately loses this determinacy given to it; for this passes over to the other, or rather has already passed over to it; the alien [factor] soliciting the force appears as universal medium, but only through the fact that it has been solicited thereto by it; i.e., however, it posits it thus and is rather itself essentially universal medium; it posits the soliciting [factor] thus, because this other determination is essential to it, i.e., because it is rather itself.
zh: 两个力的游戏由此就在于两者这种相反的规定，就在于它们在这种规定中的彼此为对方存在，以及诸规定的绝对直接的混淆——一种过渡，唯有通过这种过渡，这些规定才存在，而在这些规定中，两个力看起来是独立出现的。
例如，推动者被设定为普遍介质，而被推动者则被设定为被逼回自身之中的力；但前者之所以本身是普遍介质，只是由于另一个是被逼回自身之中的力；或者说，后者毋宁说才是前者的推动者，并且才把前者弄成介质。

前者只有通过另一个才有自己的规定性，并且只有当它被另一个推动去成为推动者时，它才是推动者；它同样直接失去这个被给予它的规定性；因为这个规定性过渡到另一个那里，或者毋宁说已经过渡到另一个那里去了；这个外来的、推动着力的东西作为普遍介质出现，但只是由于它被力推动才如此；也就是说，力把它如此设定，而力本身毋宁说本质上就是普遍介质；力这样设定那个推动者，是因为这个另一个规定性对力来说是本质性的，也就是说，因为力毋宁说就是那个推动者本身。

en: For the completion of the insight into the concept of this movement, attention may still be drawn to the fact that the differences themselves show themselves in a doubled difference, once as differences of content, in that the one extreme is force reflected into itself, while the other is the medium of the matters; the other time as differences of form, in that the one is soliciting, the other solicited, the former active, the latter passive.

According to the difference of content they are distinguished on the whole, or for us; according to the difference of form, however, they are independent, in their relation separating themselves from each other and opposed.

That thus the extremes, according to these two sides, are nothing in themselves, but that these sides, in which their distinguished essence was supposed to consist, are only vanishing moments, an immediate transition of each into the opposite, – this becomes [evident] for consciousness in the perception of the movement of force.

For us, however, as recalled above, there was also this: that in themselves the differences vanished as differences of content and of form, and that on the side of form the active, soliciting or being-for-itself [factor] was essentially the same as what on the side of content [was] force driven back into itself; the passive, solicited or being-for-an-other [factor] on the side of form the same as what on the side of content presented itself as the universal medium of the many matters.
zh: 为了完整地洞见这一运动的概念，还可以提醒一点：这些差别本身表现为一种加倍的差别，一方面作为内容的差别，即一个极端是在自身中反思的力，另一个则是诸质料的介质；另一方面作为形式的差别，即一个是推动者，另一个是被推动者，前者主动，后者被动。
按内容的差别，它们整个说来或对我们来说是有差别的；但按形式的差别，它们是独立的，在它们的关联中自己把自己彼此分开，并且相互对立。
于是，两个极端按这两个方面说来自在什么也不是，而这两个本应构成它们有差别的本质的方面，只是正在消失的环节，是每一个直接向对立面的过渡——这一点在知觉中成为意识所看到的力的运动。
但对我们来说，正如上面已经提醒过的，还有一点：自在说来，内容和形式的差别都消失了，而在形式这一侧，本质上主动的、推动的或自为存在着的，就是内容那一侧作为被逼回自身之中的力所是的东西；形式这一侧被动的、被推动的或为他存在着的，就是内容那一侧表现为许多质料的一般介质的东西。

en: It follows from this that the concept of force becomes actual through the doubling into two forces, and how it becomes so.

These two forces exist as essences that are for themselves; but their existence is a movement against each other such that their being is much more a pure being-posited through an other, i.e., that their being has much more the pure meaning of vanishing.

They are not [present] as extremes that retained something firm for themselves and only sent an external property against each other into the middle and into their contact; but what they are, they are only in this middle and contact.

In this there is immediately just as much the being-driven-back-into-itself or the being-for-itself of force as the expression, the soliciting as the being-solicited; these moments are hereby not distributed over two independent extremes, which would only offer each other an opposed point, but their essence is this absolutely: each to be only through the other, and [that] what each is thus through the other, it immediately no longer is, in that it is it.
They have hereby in fact no substances of their own that carried and preserved them.

The concept of force rather preserves itself as the essence in its actuality itself; force as actual is absolutely only in the expression, which is at the same time nothing other than a self-sublating.

This actual force, represented as free of its expression and as being for itself, is the force driven back into itself; but this determinacy is in fact, as has resulted, itself only a moment of expression.

The truth of force therefore remains only the thought of it; and without support the moments of its actuality, its substances and its movement, collapse together into an undifferentiated unity, which is not the force driven back into itself (for this is itself only such a moment), but this unity is its concept as concept.

The realization of force is therefore at the same time loss of reality; in this it has rather become a wholly other, namely this universality, which the understanding cognizes first or immediately as its essence and which also proves itself as its essence on its supposed reality, on the actual substances.
zh: 由此得出：力的概念通过分裂为两个力而成为现实的，以及它是如何成为现实的。
这两个力作为自为存在着的本质而存在；但它们的存在是一种彼此相对的运动，以致它们的存在毋宁说是通过一个他者而被纯粹设定，也就是说，它们的存在毋宁说具有消失这一纯粹含义。
它们并不是作为这样的极端而存在：这些极端各自保留着某种坚固的东西，只是把一种外在属性彼此送到中间和它们的接触之中；它们是什么，它们只是在中间和接触之中才是。
在这种中间和接触之中，直接既有力被逼回自身之中或力的自为存在，也有表现，既有推动也有被推动；这些环节由此并没有分配给两个独立的极端，好像这两个极端只是各自向对方提供一个相反的尖端，它们的本质毋宁说恰恰是：每一个都只通过另一个而存在，而每一个这样通过另一个而成为的东西，当它是它时，就直接不再是它了。
它们由此事实上并没有自己的实体来承载和保持它们。
力的概念毋宁说在其现实性本身之中作为本质而保持自身；作为现实的力，它绝对只是在表现之中，而表现同时无非是一种自我扬弃。
这种现实的力，被表象为脱离了自己的表现并自为存在着，就是被逼回自身之中的力；但正如已经得出的结果那样，这个规定性事实上本身只是表现的一个环节。
所以力的真理只留下对力的思想；而力的现实性的诸环节，它的实体和它的运动，都无持守地崩塌为一种无差别的统一，这种统一不是被逼回自身之中的力（因为这种力本身也只是这样一个环节），而这种统一是力作为概念的概念。
力的实现所以同时就是实在性的丧失；力在这方面毋宁说已经变成了一个完全不同的东西，即这种普遍性，知性首先或直接把它认作力的本质，而它在力应有的实在性上、在现实的实体上也表明自己是力的本质。

en: Insofar as we regard the first universal as the concept of the understanding, in which force is not yet for itself, the second is now its essence as it presents itself in and for itself.

Or conversely, if we regard the first universal as the immediate, which was supposed to be an actual object for consciousness, then this second is determined as the negative of the sensuously objective force; it is force as it is in its true essence only as object of the understanding; that first one would be force driven back into itself, or force as substance; but this second is the inner of things, as inner, which is the same as the concept as concept.
zh: 既然我们把第一个普遍者看作知性的概念，而力在其中还不是自为的，那么第二个普遍者现在就是力的本质，即它自在自为地呈现出来的样子。
或者反过来，如果我们把第一个普遍者看作直接的东西，而它本该是意识的一个现实对象，那么这第二个就被规定为感性对象性的力的否定物；它就是力本身，正如力在其真正的本质中只是作为知性的对象那样；那第一个会是逼回自身之中的力，或者说力作为实体；而这第二个则是物的内在，作为内在，它与作为概念的概念是同一个东西。

en: This true essence of things has now determined itself in such a way that it is not immediately for consciousness, but that the latter has a mediated relation to the inner and, as understanding, looks through this middle of the play of forces into the true background of things.
The middle that closes together the two extremes, understanding and the inner, is the developed being of force, which for the understanding itself is now a vanishing.
It is therefore called appearance, for we call semblance the being that is immediately in itself a non-being.
But it is not only a semblance, but appearance, a whole of semblance.
It is this whole, as whole or universal, that constitutes the inner, the play of forces, as the reflection of the same into itself.

In it, for consciousness, the essences of perception are posited in an objective way as they are in themselves, namely as moments that, without rest and being, immediately transform themselves into the opposite, the One immediately into the universal, the essential immediately into the unessential, and conversely.
This play of forces is therefore the developed negative; but its truth is the positive, namely the universal, the object that is in itself.

– Its being for consciousness is mediated through the movement of appearance, in which the being of perception and the sensuously objective in general have only a negative meaning, so that consciousness reflects itself out of it into itself as into the true, but as consciousness again makes this true into the objective inner and distinguishes this reflection of things from its reflection into itself; just as the mediating movement is likewise still an objective one for it.

This inner is therefore an extreme over against consciousness; but it is for that reason the true for it, because in it, as in the in-itself, consciousness at the same time has the certainty of itself, or the moment of its being-for-itself; but of this ground it is not yet conscious, for the being-for-itself that the inner should have in itself would be nothing other than the negative movement; but this movement is for consciousness still the objectively vanishing appearance, not yet its own being-for-itself; the inner is therefore indeed concept for it, but it does not yet know the nature of the concept.
zh: 物的这个真正的本质现在已把自己规定成这样：它不是直接地为意识的，而是意识与内在有一种中介性的关系，并且作为知性，透过力的游戏的这一中间项，看入物的真正背景。
把两个极端，即知性和内在，联结起来的这个中间项，就是力的已经展开的存在，而这对知性本身来说如今是一种消失。
它因此叫做现象，因为我们把直接在自己身上就是非存在的那种存在叫做假象。
但它不只是假象，而是现象，是假象的一个整体。
正是这个整体，作为整体或普遍者，构成了内在，即力的游戏，作为它在自身中的反思。
在它之中，知觉的诸本质为意识以对象性的方式被设定为它们自在所是的样子，即作为没有静止和存在而直接转变为对立面的诸环节，一直接转变为普遍者，本质的东西直接转变为非本质的东西，反过来也一样。
所以力的游戏就是展开的否定物；但它的真理却是肯定物，即普遍者，自在存在着的对象。
——它之为意识而存在，是由现象的运动中介起来的，在这个运动里，知觉的存在和一般感性对象性的东西都只有否定的含义，所以意识从中反思到自身之中，即反思到真的东西之中，但意识作为意识又把这个真的东西重新弄成对象性的内在，并把物的这种反思与它自己向自身之中的反思区别开来；正如那种进行中介的运动对它来说同样还是对象性的。
所以这个内在对意识来说是一个与它相对的极端；但它因此对意识来说就是真的东西，因为意识在内在之中，如同在自在之中，同时拥有它自己的确定性，或者说拥有它的自为存在的环节；但意识还没有意识到这个根据，因为内在本应在自己身上具有的自为存在，无非就是那否定的运动；但这种运动对意识来说还是对象性地消失着的现象，还不是它自己的自为存在；所以内在对意识来说诚然是概念，但意识还不认识概念的本性。

en: In this inner true, as the absolutely universal, which has been purified of the opposition of the universal and the singular and has become for the understanding, there now first opens up, above the sensuous world as the appearing world, a supersensuous world as the true world, above the vanishing this-side the abiding beyond, an in-itself that is the first and therefore itself imperfect appearance of reason, or only the pure element in which truth has its essence.
zh: 在这个内在的真的东西里，作为绝对普遍者——它已经清除了普遍者与个别者的对立，并已成为知性的东西——，现在才在感性世界作为显现着的世界之上，敞开出一个超感性的世界作为真的世界，在消逝着的此岸之上则是持存的彼岸，一个自在，它是理性的最初的现象、因而本身还不完善的现象，或者只是真理在其中拥有自己本质的那个纯粹元素。

en: Our object is hereby now the syllogism that has as its extremes the inner of things and the understanding and as its middle appearance; but the movement of this syllogism gives the further determination of what the understanding, through the middle, beholds in the inner, and the experience that it makes concerning this relation of being-closed-together.
zh: 我们的对象由此现在就是那个推论：它以物的内在和知性为自己的两个极端，以现象为自己的中间项；但这个推论的运动却给出了进一步的规定，即知性透过中间项在内在里所看到的东西，以及知性关于这种被联结在一起的关系所取得的经验。

en: The inner is still a pure beyond for consciousness, for it does not yet find itself in it; it is empty, for it is only the nothing of appearance, and positively the simple universal.
This way of the inner's being agrees immediately with those who say that the inner of things cannot be cognized; but the ground would have to be conceived differently.

Of this inner as it is here immediately there is indeed no knowledge, but not because reason would be too short-sighted or limited, or whatever else one wants to call it (about which nothing is yet known here, for we have not yet penetrated so deep), but for the sake of the simple nature of the matter itself, because in the empty nothing is cognized, or, expressed from the other side, because it is precisely determined as the beyond of consciousness.

– The result is admittedly the same if a blind man is placed in the wealth of the supersensuous world – if it has one, whether it be its own proper content, or consciousness itself be this content – and if a seeing man is placed in pure darkness or, if you will, in pure light, if it is only this; the seeing man sees in his pure light as little as in his pure darkness, and just as much as the blind man in the fullness of the wealth that would lie before him.

If there were nothing further with the inner and the being-closed-together with it through appearance, nothing would remain but to hold to appearance, i.e. to take something as true of which we know that it is not true, or – so that there may yet be something in the empty, which has indeed first come to be as emptiness of objective things, but, as emptiness in itself, must also be taken as the emptiness of all spiritual relations and of the differences of consciousness as consciousness – so that therefore in this wholly empty [realm], which is also called the holy, there may yet be something, to fill it with dreams, appearances that consciousness itself produces; it would have to put up with being dealt with so badly, for it would be worthy of nothing better, since dreams themselves are still better than its emptiness.
zh: 内在对意识来说还纯粹是彼岸，因为意识还没有在它里面找到自己；它是空的，因为它只是现象的无，而肯定地说则是单纯的普遍者。
内在的这种存在方式直接附和那些说物的内在不可认识的人；但那个根据却必须另作把握。
关于这个内在，如它在这里是直接的，诚然没有知识，但这并不是因为理性太短视或太狭隘，或者人们想怎么称呼它（关于这一点这里还一无所知，因为我们还没有深入到那么深），而是由于事情本身的单纯本性，因为在空无中什么都认识不到，或者从另一面来说，因为内在恰恰被规定为意识的彼岸。
——结果诚然是同样的：如果把一个盲人放进超感性世界的财富里——如果它有财富的话，不管那是超感性世界自己特有的内容，还是意识本身就是这个内容——，又把一个看得见的人放进纯粹的黑暗里，或者随你怎么说，放进纯粹的光明里，只要它只是这个；那么看得见的人在纯粹的光明里看到的并不比在纯粹的黑暗里多，恰好和盲人在他面前摆着的那份财富的丰盈里所看到的一样多。

如果内在以及通过现象与内在联结在一起这件事不过如此，那就只剩下一条路：固守现象，也就是说，把某种我们知道它并非真的东西当作真的；或者——为了在那个空无中毕竟还有点东西，而这个空无虽然最初是作为对象性东西的空无而产生的，但作为自在的空无，也必须被看作一切精神关系和意识之为意识的差别的空无——，也就是说，为了在这个如此完全空无、甚至也被称为神圣之物的东西里毕竟有点什么，就用梦幻、用意识自己产生出来的现象去填满它；它只好忍受人们这样糟糕地对待它，因为它不配得到更好的待遇，既然梦幻本身还比它的空无要好些。

en: But the inner, or the supersensuous beyond, has come into being; it comes from appearance, and appearance is its mediation; or appearance is its essence and in fact its fulfillment.
The supersensuous is the sensuous and the perceived, posited as it is in truth; but the truth of the sensuous and the perceived is to be appearance.
The supersensuous is therefore appearance as appearance.

– If it is thereby thought that the supersensuous is thus the sensuous world, or the world as it is for immediate sense-certainty and perception, then this is an inverted understanding; for appearance is rather not the world of sensuous knowing and perceiving as existing, but is posited as sublated, or in truth as inner.
It is usually said that the supersensuous is not appearance; but in that case, by appearance is not understood appearance, but rather the sensuous world as itself real actuality.
zh: 但内在，或者说超感性的彼岸，是产生出来的，它来自现象，而现象就是它的中介；或者说，现象就是它的本质，而且事实上就是它的充实。
超感性之物就是感性之物和被知觉到的东西，被设定为它们在真理中所是的样子；但感性之物和被知觉到的东西的真理，就是它们是现象。
所以超感性之物就是作为现象的现象。
——如果在这里人们以为，超感性之物因此就是感性世界，或者说就是那对直接的感性确定性和知觉来说所是的世界，那么这就是一种颠倒的理解；因为现象毋宁说并不是作为存在着的感性知识和知觉的世界，而是作为被扬弃了的世界、或者说在真理中作为内在的世界而被设定的。
人们通常说，超感性之物不是现象；但这样一来，在现象这个名称下所理解的并不是现象，而毋宁说是把感性世界当作本身实在的现实性。

en: The understanding that is our object finds itself at precisely this position, that the inner has become for it only first as the universal, still unfulfilled in-itself; the play of forces has only this negative meaning, not to be in itself, and only this positive one, to be the mediating, but outside it.
But its relation to the inner through mediation is its movement, through which it will fulfill the inner for itself.
– Immediately for it is the play of forces; but the true is for it the simple inner; the movement of force is therefore likewise only as simple in general the true.

But we have seen of this play of forces that it has this constitution, that the force which is solicited by another force is likewise the soliciting [factor] for this other, which itself first becomes soliciting only through this.

Herein there is likewise present only the immediate exchange, or the absolute interchange of the determinacy that makes up the sole content of what appears, to be either universal medium or negative unity.

In its determinate appearance it immediately ceases to be what it appears as; through its determinate appearance it solicits the other side, which thereby expresses itself; i.e. this side is immediately now what the first was supposed to be.
These two sides, the relation of soliciting and the relation of determinate opposed content, is each for itself the absolute inversion and confounding.

But these two relations are themselves again the same; and the difference of form, to be the solicited and the soliciting, is the same as the difference of content: the solicited as such, namely the passive medium; the soliciting, on the other hand, the active, the negative unity or the One.

Hereby all difference of particular forces that were supposed to be present in this movement vanishes altogether over against one another, for they rested solely on those differences; and the difference of the forces likewise coalesces with those two into one.

Thus neither force, nor soliciting and being-solicited, nor the determinacy of being a subsisting medium and a unity reflected into itself, is anything singly for itself, nor are they different oppositions; but what is in this absolute change is only the difference as universal, or as such a one into which the many oppositions have reduced themselves.
This difference as universal is therefore the simple [element] in the play of force itself and the true of it; it is the law of force.
zh: 作为我们对象的知性正处在这个位置上：内在对它来说最初还只是作为普遍的、尚未被充实的自在而出现的；力的游戏只有这样一个否定的含义，即它不是自在的，也只有这样一个肯定的含义，即它是进行中介的东西，但却在知性之外。
但它通过中介而与内在的关系，就是它的运动，它将通过这一运动为它自己把内在充实起来。
——对知性来说，直接的东西就是力的游戏；但真的东西对知性来说却是单纯的内在；所以力的运动同样只有作为一般单纯的东西才是真的东西。
但我们已经看到，力的游戏具有这样的性质：被另一个力所推动的力，同样也是这个另一个力的推动者，而这另一个力本身只有通过这种方式才成为推动者。
在这里同样只存在着直接的交替，或者说规定性的绝对互换，而这种规定性构成了出现的东西的唯一内容：要么是普遍介质，要么是否定的统一。
它在自己特定的出现中直接就不再是它出现为的那个东西；它通过自己特定的出现推动另一面，而另一面由此表现自己；也就是说，这另一面现在直接就是那第一个本该是的东西。
这两个方面，即推动的关系和特定的对立内容的关系，每一个自为地都是绝对的颠倒和混淆。
但这两个关系本身又都是同一个东西；而形式的差别，即成为被推动者和推动者，也就是内容上的差别，即：被推动者本身，也就是被动的介质；而推动者则是主动的东西，是否定的统一或者一。
这样一来，那些本应在这种运动中存在的特殊力彼此之间的一切差别就整个消失了，因为它们仅仅以那些差别为依据；而诸力的差别同样也与那两者合而为一。
所以，无论是力，还是推动和被推动，还是成为持存着的介质和在自身中反思的统一这一规定性，都不是单个地自为的什么，也不是各种不同的对立；毋宁说，在这种绝对交替中存在的东西，只是作为普遍的差别，或者说只是那许多对立都已还原于其中的这样一种差别。
所以，这个作为普遍的差别，就是力的游戏本身身上的单纯东西，也就是它里面真的东西；它就是力的规律。

en: To simple difference the absolutely changing appearance is reduced through its relation to the simplicity of the inner or of the understanding, the inner is at first only the universal in itself; but this in-itself simple universal is essentially just as absolutely the universal difference, for it is the result of the change itself, or the change is its essence, but the change as posited in the inner, as it is in truth, is hereby taken up into that same inner as an equally absolutely universal, calm, self-same difference.
Or the negation is an essential moment of the universal, and it, or mediation, is therefore in the universal the universal difference.

It is expressed in the law as the constant image of the unstable appearance, the supersensuous world is hereby a calm realm of laws, indeed beyond the perceived world, for the latter presents the law only through constant alteration, but equally present in it and its immediate, still copy.
zh: 绝对变换着的现象通过它与内在或知性的单纯性的关系，就变成单纯的差别，内在首先只是自在的普遍者；但这个自在单纯着的普遍者本质上同样绝对是普遍的差别，因为它是变换本身的结果，或者说变换就是它的本质，不过变换作为被设定在内在之中的东西、如同它在真理中那样，就由此被纳入这同一个内在之中，成为同样绝对普遍的、平静的、自身保持等同的差别。
或者说，否定是普遍者的本质环节，而它、或者说中介，因此在普遍者中就是普遍的差别。
它在规律中被表达出来，作为不稳定的现象的恒常图像，超感性世界由此就是一个平静的规律王国，它虽然在被知觉到的世界彼岸，因为后者只通过不断的改变来呈现规律，但同样就在这世界里是当下的，是后者直接的、寂静的摹本。

en: This realm of laws is indeed the truth of the understanding, which has its content in the difference that is in the law; but it is at the same time only its first truth and does not fill out the appearance.
The law is present in it, but it is not its whole presence; under ever different circumstances it has an ever different actuality.
Thereby there remains over for the appearance itself a side that is not in the inner; or it is in truth not yet posited as appearance, as sublated being-for-itself.
This deficiency of the law must likewise come to light in the law itself.
What it seems to lack is that it indeed has the difference itself on it, but as a universal, indeterminate one.
But insofar as it is not law in general but a law, it has determinacy on it; and there are thereby indeterminately many laws present.
But this multiplicity is itself rather a deficiency; for it contradicts the principle of the understanding, for which, as consciousness of the simple inner, the in-itself universal unity is the true.

The understanding must therefore rather let the many laws collapse into one law, just as e.g. the law according to which the stone falls and the law according to which the heavenly spheres move have been comprehended as one law.

But with this collapsing into one another the laws lose their determinacy; the law becomes ever more superficial, and there is thereby in fact found not the unity of these determinate laws but a law that omits their determinacy; just as the one law that unites in itself the laws of the fall of bodies on the earth and of heavenly motion in fact does not express them both.
The unification of all laws in universal attraction expresses no further content than precisely the mere concept of the law itself, which is posited therein as existing.
Universal attraction says only this, that everything has a constant difference from another.

The understanding means thereby to have found a universal law that expresses universal actuality as such; but it has in fact found only the concept of the law itself, though in such a way that it at the same time declares this with it: all actuality is in itself lawful.

The expression of universal attraction therefore has great importance insofar as it is directed against thoughtless representation, to which everything presents itself in the shape of contingency and to which determinacy has the form of sensuous self-subsistence.
zh: 这个规律王国诚然是知性的真理，它的内容就在规律中存在的那个差别里；但它同时只是知性的第一个真理，并没有把现象填满。
规律在它里面是当下的，但它并不是它的全部当下；规律在总是不同的情况下有总是不同的现实性。
现象本身由此还剩下一个方面，这个方面不在内在之中；或者说，现象在真理中还没有被设定为现象，还没有被设定为被扬弃了的自为存在。
规律的这种缺陷必然同样在规律自身身上显露出来。
它看起来缺少的东西就是，它虽然自身具有差别本身，但只是作为普遍的、不确定的差别。
但既然它不是一般意义上的规律，而是一个规律，它就自身具有规定性；于是也就有不确定地多的规律存在。
但这种多数性毋宁说本身就是一种缺陷；因为它与知性的原则相矛盾，而知性作为对单纯内在的意识，是以自在的普遍统一为真的东西的。
所以知性毋宁必须让这许多规律合并为一个规律，例如石头下落所遵循的规律和天体运行所遵循的规律，就曾被以概念把握为一个规律。
但随这种互相合并，规律就失去了它们的规定性；规律变得越来越表面，而由此实际上找到的并不是这些特定规律的统一，而是一个丢掉了它们的规定性的规律；正如那一个把物体在地球上下落的规律和天体运动的规律联合于自身的规律，实际上并没有表达出这两者。
把所有规律统一于普遍引力之中，所表达的内容不外乎就是规律自身那个在其中被设定为存在着的单纯概念。
普遍引力只说出这一点，即一切东西对别的东西都有一种恒常的差别。
知性在这里意谓自己找到了一条表达普遍现实性本身的普遍规律；但它实际上只找到了规律自身的概念，不过它同时也就说出了这一点：一切现实性在自身都是合乎规律的。
因此，普遍引力这一说法之所以有很大的重要性，是因为它针对着无思想的表象，在这种表象看来，一切都以偶然性的形态呈现出来，而规定性则具有感性的独立性的形式。

en: Thus universal attraction, or the pure concept of the law, stands over against the determinate laws.
Insofar as this pure concept is considered as the essence or as the true inner, the determinacy of the determinate law itself still belongs to appearance, or rather to sensuous being.
But the pure concept of the law goes not only beyond the law which, itself a determinate one, stands over against other determinate laws, but also beyond the law as such.

The determinacy of which there was talk is properly itself only a vanishing moment, which here can no longer occur as essentiality; for only the law is present as the true; but the concept of the law is turned against the law itself.

For on the law the difference itself is immediately apprehended and taken up into the universal, but thereby a subsistence of the moments whose relation it expresses, as indifferent and in-themselves-existing essences.

But these parts of the difference on the law are at the same time themselves determinate sides; the pure concept of the law, as universal attraction, must be grasped in its true meaning in such a way that in it, as the absolutely simple, the differences that are present on the law as such again retire into the inner as simple unity — it is the inner necessity of the law.
zh: 于是，与那些特定的规律相对立的，就是普遍引力，或者说规律的纯粹概念。
只要这个纯粹概念被看作本质、或者被看作真的内在，那么特定规律的规定性本身就还属于现象，或者毋宁说属于感性的存在。
但规律的纯粹概念不仅超出了那个本身是特定的、并与别的特定规律相对立的规律，而且还超出了规律本身。
刚才所说的那种规定性，其实本身只是正在消失的环节，它在这里再也不能作为本质性出现；因为这里只有规律作为真的东西而存在；但规律的概念却转而与规律本身相对。
因为在规律身上，差别本身直接被把握到并被纳入普遍者之中，但由此诸环节也就有了一种持存，即成为漠不相关的、自在存在着的本质，而规律所表达的正是这些环节的关系。
但规律身上差别的这些部分，本身同时又是特定的方面；规律的纯粹概念作为普遍引力，必须按其真的含义这样来理解：在它这个绝对单纯者之中，规律本身所具有的那些差别又重新回到内在之中，成为单纯的统一——它就是规律的这种内在必然性。

en: The law is thereby present in a doubled way: the one time as law on which the differences are expressed as independent moments, the other time in the form of simple having-retreated-into-itself, which can again be called force, but in such a way that it is not the force driven back but force in general, or as the concept of force — an abstraction that draws into itself the differences of what attracts and what is attracted.
Thus e.g. simple electricity is the force, but the expression of the difference falls into the law: this difference is positive and negative electricity.

In the motion of fall, the force is the simple [element], gravity, which has the law that the magnitudes of the distinguished moments of motion, the elapsed time and the traversed space, relate to each other as root and square.

Electricity itself is not the difference in itself, or in its essence the double essence of positive and negative electricity; hence one is accustomed to say that it has the law of being in this way, or indeed that it has the property of expressing itself thus.
This property is indeed the essential and only property of this force, or it is necessary to it.
But necessity is here an empty word; force must, precisely because it must, thus double itself.

If, to be sure, positive electricity is posited, negative electricity is also in itself necessary; for the positive is only as relation to a negative, or the positive is in itself the difference from itself, just as the negative likewise is.

But that electricity as such divides itself in this way, this is not in itself the necessary; as simple force it is indifferent to its law of being positive and negative, and if we call the former its concept and the latter its being, then its concept is indifferent to its being; it merely has this property; that is just to say, it is not necessary to it in itself.
— This indifference receives another shape when it is said that it belongs to the definition of electricity to be positive and negative, or that this is absolutely its concept and essence.
